observations: body L7: the sign over the lām-alif of «الٱسْتِوَاء» is the waṣla, of the shape of the waṣla of «الٱجْتِمَاعَاتُ» on p. 327.
body L9: the 2 and the 9 of «١٢٩» touch (5.6 points together, as «٢٦» on p. 326); the two digits of «٢٢» have one crest each (3.1 and 3.2 points); a 3 measures 4.6-4.8 points on this page.
body L13: the hamza of «اِخْتِفَاء» is printed blotted, with a closed loop at its head.
body L16: the 4 of the line number 14 after «٧٤» is printed faint, its diagonal broken, so that it resembles 1.
body L18, L20: «الحاصة» (L18) and «الحاصّة» (L20) are printed without the dot of khāʾ, as on p. 328; transcribed as printed.
body L21: a speck (0.8 by 1.3 points) is printed above the comma after «٧٧»; the upper dot of the semicolons of this page measures 1.6 by 1.4 points (L10, L16). Transcribed as a comma.
body L22: a speck (0.8 point) is printed at the foot of «٧٦»; not transcribed.
body L6, L14: the dash at the end of L6 and the dash after «خلف» (L14) are printed 7.8 and 8.0 points long, shorter than the other em dashes of the page (9.2-10.4 points).
body L23, L26: the dash before «اختلاف» is printed in two pieces, of 8.4 and 1.1 points (L23) and of 1.3 and 7.1 points (L26), together of the length of an em dash.

body L7, L35, L36, L40: «al–Battānī» (L7), «aṭ–Ṭūsī» (L35) and «Bouché–Leclercq» (L40) are printed with an en dash, «ad-dīn» (L35) and «al-Bīrūnī» (L36) with a hyphen; the hyphen of «al-Bīrūnī» is printed short (2.2 points).
body L24: a dot is printed below the α of «σφαίρας»; not transcribed.

body L3, L23, L32: «ὀρϑῆς» (L23) and «νυχϑήμερον» (L32) are printed with the open theta ϑ. The omicron of «ὀρϑῆς» is the δ-shaped sort whose head turns to the left (smooth breathing); the head of «ὁ» (L3) turns to the right (rough breathing).
body L34, L35: the kasra under the khāʾ of «المِرِّيخِ» (L34) stands just above the a of «Antaris» (L35), which has no accent.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
